prompt.high_level_description: Repair the top band of an existing pixel art background of a ruined burial grove, keeping its exact palette, light, scale, oblique 2.5D camera and fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters. The broken pillars in this band are gone. Only a row of knee-high broken wall stumps and a few fallen blocks remain along the bottom of the band, and everything above them is open sky, one plain flat light dusty grey-mauve colour, completely empty.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Open sky of one flat pale colour filling most of the band, above a low row of broken wall stumps.

elements.desc: A low row of knee-high broken wall stumps and fallen blocks along the bottom of the band, open flat sky above them.
